title: Bio-derived tannic acid-Eu(III) coordination synergizes with aluminum diethylphosphinate for low-loading and high-efficiency flame retardancy in PA66
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23399-23409
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02012G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zongpin Liu, Wayne Hsu, Yincai Wu, Shenglong Wang, Junwei Zeng, Fenglong Lin, Lijun Song
A bio-derived europium-tannic acid complex (Eu@TA) was synthesized via a facile aqueous coordination strategy, leveraging the polyphenolic structure of tannic acid as a multidentate ligand and europium ions (Eu3+) as the coordination center.
